summary.historical_cap_handling: Each inventory row retains its actual sampled cap. Earlier caps are not silently superseded by later caps: only same exact prompt IDs + seed + mode can establish a later continuation. The repeated rows with identical result SHA (e.g. inventory rows 1/51, 2/52, 8/12, 9/11) are duplicated inventory references, not new trials. Cap extensions listed in source metadata remain separate observations; no cap-only completion/failure inference is made.
